text.en:
All assets, properties, records, funds, personnel, liabilities and all
other functions, tasks and responsibilities of the Task Force shall be transferred to the
Pinatubo Project Management Office (PPMO) attached to the HUDCC.

The PPMO shall undertake the estate management functions over the
resettlement sites transferred to HUDCC and all other non-resettlement functions, such as
funds accounting, closing of books of accounts, turnover of facilities, properties and
equipment, and the preparation of the Terminal Report of the defunct MPC.
POMA Outsoing * 06391

2

The DBM shall assist in the creation of the PPMO. To provide
continuity, the initial staff of the PPMO shall be composed of the incumbent personnel of -
the Task Force, as recommended by the DBM. The DBM shall also assist the HUDCC in
the creation of plantilla positions and the provision of operating funds for the PPMP.

All balances of Pinatubo (TFP-101) funds shall be deemed transferred to
the PPMO to cover the implementation of on-going residual works, including the
completion of the titling and documentation requirements over Pinatubo resettlement
lands, and for the implementation of other urgent projects until such funds shall have
been fully exhausted.

This Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 7th day of November, in the year of Our
Lord, two thousand and one.
By the President:
ALBERTO G. ROMULO
Executive Secretary
